*.error: Error description returned by the server.
*.vector: Three-component vector in the named frame.
*.wrench: Force and torque in the named frame.
*.twist: Linear and angular velocity in the named frame.
*.accel: Linear and angular acceleration in the named frame.
*.pose: Position and orientation in the named frame.
*.inertia: Mass, center of mass and inertia tensor in the named frame.
*.uuid: The 16 octets of the goal identifier.

franka_msgs/msg/Elbow.position: Measured elbow configuration from libfranka elbow. Element 0 is joint 3 position in radians. Element 1 is the joint 4 flip direction (−1, 0, or +1).
franka_msgs/msg/Elbow.desired_position: Desired elbow configuration from elbow_d, with joint 3 position in radians followed by the joint 4 flip direction.
franka_msgs/msg/Elbow.commanded_position: Commanded elbow configuration from elbow_c, with joint 3 position in radians followed by the joint 4 flip direction.
franka_msgs/msg/Elbow.commanded_velocity: Commanded joint 3 velocity in rad/s from delbow_c[0]. The second component is zero.
franka_msgs/msg/Elbow.commanded_acceleration: Commanded joint 3 acceleration in rad/s² from ddelbow_c[0]. The second component is zero.
franka_msgs/msg/Elbow.$type: Measured, desired and commanded elbow state.

franka_msgs/msg/CollisionIndicators.is_cartesian_linear_collision: Collision levels along the three translational Cartesian axes. A collision indication persists until reset.
franka_msgs/msg/CollisionIndicators.is_cartesian_linear_contact: Contact levels along the three translational Cartesian axes. The levels return to zero when contact disappears.
franka_msgs/msg/CollisionIndicators.is_cartesian_angular_collision: Collision levels for the three rotational Cartesian components. A collision indication persists until reset.
franka_msgs/msg/CollisionIndicators.is_cartesian_angular_contact: Contact levels for the three rotational Cartesian components. The levels return to zero when contact disappears.
franka_msgs/msg/CollisionIndicators.is_joint_collision: Collision levels in joint order, retained until reset.
franka_msgs/msg/CollisionIndicators.is_joint_contact: Contact levels in joint order, returning to zero when contact disappears.
franka_msgs/msg/CollisionIndicators.$type: Cartesian and joint contact and collision levels.

franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.header: Timestamp of the robot state and reference frame.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.time: Strictly increasing time since robot start, converted to seconds with libfranka time.toSec().
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.control_command_success_rate: Fraction of the last 100 control commands received successfully. Range 0–1. Zero when no control or motion generator loop is running.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.robot_mode: Reported robot operating mode. See the ROBOT_MODE_* constants.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.current_errors: Flags currently raised by the robot.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.last_motion_errors: Flags reported for the last motion.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.accelerometer_top: Six top-side translational acceleration samples in m/s² for joints 1–6. Each header identifies its accelerometer frame.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.accelerometer_bottom: Six bottom-side translational acceleration samples in m/s² for joints 1–6. Each header identifies its accelerometer frame.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.k_f_ext_hat_k: Estimated external wrench acting on the stiffness frame, expressed in stiffness-frame coordinates. Force in N, torque in N·m.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.o_f_ext_hat_k: Estimated external wrench acting on the stiffness frame, expressed in base coordinates. Force in N, torque in N·m.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.measured_joint_state: Measured joint position q in rad, velocity dq in rad/s and link-side torque tau_J in N·m.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.desired_joint_state: Desired joint position q_d in rad, velocity dq_d in rad/s and desired link-side torque tau_J_d in N·m.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.measured_joint_motor_state: Measured motor position theta in rad and velocity dtheta in rad/s.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.ddq_d: Desired angular acceleration of each of the seven arm joints in rad/s².
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.dtau_j: Derivative of measured link-side torque in N·m/s for each arm joint.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.tau_ext_hat_filtered: Low-pass filtered external joint torques in N·m, stored in the effort sequence.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.o_dp_ee_d: Desired end-effector twist in the base frame. Linear velocity in m/s, angular velocity in rad/s.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.o_dp_ee_c: Last commanded end-effector twist in the base frame. Linear velocity in m/s, angular velocity in rad/s.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.o_ddp_ee_c: Last commanded end-effector acceleration in the base frame. Linear acceleration in m/s², angular acceleration in rad/s².
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.ROBOT_MODE_OTHER: Reported libfranka RobotMode for other modes.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.ROBOT_MODE_USER_STOPPED: Reported libfranka RobotMode for user stop.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.ROBOT_MODE_AUTOMATIC_ERROR_RECOVERY: Reported libfranka RobotMode for automatic error recovery.
franka_msgs/msg/FrankaRobotState.$type: Timestamped arm state, errors, inertias, poses, joint samples and accelerometer measurements.

sensor_msgs/msg/JointState.header: Acquisition time shared by all joints and the reference frame.
sensor_msgs/msg/JointState.name: Joint names in sample order. Each populated joint-state sequence has the same length. An empty sequence marks an unavailable field.
sensor_msgs/msg/JointState.position: Joint positions in radians or metres, depending on joint type.
sensor_msgs/msg/JointState.velocity: Joint velocities in rad/s or m/s, depending on joint type.
sensor_msgs/msg/JointState.effort: Joint efforts in N·m or N, depending on joint type.
sensor_msgs/msg/JointState.$type: Time-coherent joint states. Each populated array has the same number of elements.

geometry_msgs/msg/Inertia.ixx: XX component of the inertia tensor about the center of mass in kg·m².
geometry_msgs/msg/Inertia.ixy: XY component of the inertia tensor about the center of mass in kg·m².
geometry_msgs/msg/Inertia.ixz: XZ component of the inertia tensor about the center of mass in kg·m².
geometry_msgs/msg/Inertia.iyy: YY component of the inertia tensor about the center of mass in kg·m².
geometry_msgs/msg/Inertia.iyz: YZ component of the inertia tensor about the center of mass in kg·m².
geometry_msgs/msg/Inertia.izz: ZZ component of the inertia tensor about the center of mass in kg·m².
geometry_msgs/msg/Inertia.$type: Mass, center of mass and symmetric inertia tensor.

geometry_msgs/msg/Quaternion.x: X component of the orientation quaternion.
geometry_msgs/msg/Quaternion.y: Y component of the orientation quaternion.
geometry_msgs/msg/Quaternion.z: Z component of the orientation quaternion.
geometry_msgs/msg/Quaternion.w: W component of the orientation quaternion.

franka_msgs/msg/TargetStatus.status: Motion status value from the IDLE, EXECUTING, TARGET_REACHED and ABORTED constants.
franka_msgs/msg/TargetStatus.$type: Reported status of a point-to-point motion.

service_msgs/msg/ServiceEventInfo.client_gid: 16 octets identifying the requesting client within this middleware session.
service_msgs/msg/ServiceEventInfo.REQUEST_SENT: Service event emitted when the client sends a request.
service_msgs/msg/ServiceEventInfo.REQUEST_RECEIVED: Service event emitted when the server receives a request.
service_msgs/msg/ServiceEventInfo.RESPONSE_SENT: Service event emitted when the server sends a response.
service_msgs/msg/ServiceEventInfo.RESPONSE_RECEIVED: Service event emitted when the client receives a response.

franka_msgs/srv/SetFullCollisionBehavior.lower_torque_thresholds_acceleration: Lower torque thresholds for the acceleration phase, in N·m for seven arm joints.
franka_msgs/srv/SetFullCollisionBehavior.lower_torque_thresholds_nominal: Lower torque thresholds for the nominal phase, in N·m for seven arm joints.
franka_msgs/srv/SetFullCollisionBehavior.lower_force_thresholds_acceleration: Lower force thresholds for the acceleration phase, in N for three forces followed by N·m for three torques.
franka_msgs/srv/SetFullCollisionBehavior.lower_force_thresholds_nominal: Lower force thresholds for the nominal phase, in N for three forces followed by N·m for three torques.
franka_msgs/srv/SetFullCollisionBehavior.upper_torque_thresholds_acceleration: Upper torque thresholds for the acceleration phase, in N·m for seven arm joints.
franka_msgs/srv/SetFullCollisionBehavior.upper_torque_thresholds_nominal: Upper torque thresholds for the nominal phase, in N·m for seven arm joints.
franka_msgs/srv/SetFullCollisionBehavior.upper_force_thresholds_acceleration: Upper force thresholds for the acceleration phase, in N for three forces followed by N·m for three torques.
franka_msgs/srv/SetFullCollisionBehavior.upper_force_thresholds_nominal: Upper force thresholds for the nominal phase, in N for three forces followed by N·m for three torques.

franka_msgs/srv/SetForceTorqueCollisionB.lower_torque_thresholds_nominal: Lower torque thresholds for the nominal phase, in N·m for seven arm joints.
franka_msgs/srv/SetForceTorqueCollisionB.lower_force_thresholds_nominal: Lower force thresholds for the nominal phase, in N for three forces followed by N·m for three torques.
franka_msgs/srv/SetForceTorqueCollisionB.upper_torque_thresholds_nominal: Upper torque thresholds for the nominal phase, in N·m for seven arm joints.
franka_msgs/srv/SetForceTorqueCollisionB.upper_force_thresholds_nominal: Upper force thresholds for the nominal phase, in N for three forces followed by N·m for three torques.

franka_msgs/action/Grasp_Goal.epsilon: Tolerated inward and outward deviations from the requested width.

franka_msgs/msg/GraspEpsilon.inner: Inward tolerance in metres when the measured grasp width is smaller than the commanded width.
franka_msgs/msg/GraspEpsilon.outer: Outward tolerance in metres when the measured grasp width is larger than the commanded width.

franka_msgs/srv/SetLoad_Request.mass: Mass of the load in kg.
franka_msgs/srv/SetLoad_Request.load_inertia: Rotational inertia in kg·m² about the center of mass, as a column-major 3×3 matrix.

franka_msgs/action/PTPMotion_Goal.goal_joint_configuration: Desired joint angles in rad, in joint order. The upstream motion handler requires the number of entries to match its joint position target.
franka_msgs/action/PTPMotion_Goal.maximum_joint_velocities: Maximum allowed angular velocities for the motion in rad/s.
franka_msgs/action/PTPMotion_Goal.goal_tolerance: Joint position tolerance in rad. Target reached also requires joint velocities below the upstream small-velocity threshold.

franka_spine_msgs/msg/SpineState.state: Reported spine state, one of NotReadyToSwitchOn, SwitchedOff, ReadyToSwitchOn, MotorOff, SwitchedOn, QuickStopActive, FaultReactionActive, Fault or Unknown.
franka_spine_msgs/msg/SpineState.$type: Periodic spine state sample on ~/state. The valid flag reports freshness.
franka_spine_msgs/msg/SpineState.header: Acquisition time and reference frame for this spine sample.

franka_spine_msgs/srv/GetSpineState_Resp.state: Reported spine state, one of NotReadyToSwitchOn, SwitchedOff, ReadyToSwitchOn, MotorOff, SwitchedOn, QuickStopActive, FaultReactionActive, Fault or Unknown.

builtin_interfaces/msg/Time.nanosec: Nanoseconds added to sec, in [0, 1000000000). Negative times use a negative seconds component and nonnegative nanoseconds.
builtin_interfaces/msg/Time.$type: ROS time in seconds and nanoseconds.

geometry_msgs/msg/Point.x: Position on the X axis in metres.
geometry_msgs/msg/Point.y: Position on the Y axis in metres.
geometry_msgs/msg/Point.z: Position on the Z axis in metres.

geometry_msgs/msg/Vector3.x: X component of a vector, in units determined by the enclosing message.
geometry_msgs/msg/Vector3.y: Y component of a vector, in units determined by the enclosing message.
geometry_msgs/msg/Vector3.z: Z component of a vector, in units determined by the enclosing message.
geometry_msgs/msg/Vector3.$type: Three-dimensional vector anchored at the origin.

franka_msgs/msg/Errors.$type: Libfranka error flags exposed by the ROS 2 state translation.

franka_msgs/srv/SetCartesianStiffness.$type: Cartesian impedance in the stiffness frame.

franka_msgs/srv/SetForceTorqueCollisionB.$type: Nominal joint torque and Cartesian force/torque collision thresholds.

franka_msgs/srv/SetFullCollisionBehavior.$type: Joint and Cartesian collision thresholds for acceleration and nominal motion phases.

franka_msgs/srv/SetLoad.$type: Payload mass, center of mass and inertia.

franka_msgs/srv/SetStiffnessFrame.$type: Transform for the stiffness frame relative to the TCP frame.

franka_msgs/srv/SetTCPFrame.$type: Transform describing the TCP frame relative to the end effector.

franka_msgs/action/Grasp.$type: Gripper grasp with width, tolerances, speed and force.

franka_msgs/action/Move.$type: Movement to a specified gripper width.

franka_msgs/action/PTPMotion.$type: Point-to-point arm motion in joint space.

franka_spine_msgs/msg/SpinePosition.$type: Periodic spine position sample on ~/position. The valid flag reports freshness.
franka_spine_msgs/msg/SpinePosition.header: Acquisition time and reference frame for this spine sample.

franka_spine_msgs/msg/SpineParameters.$type: Aggregated spine parameters reported by GetParameters.
franka_spine_msgs/msg/SpineParameters.user_limits: User-defined upper and lower spine travel limits in metres.

franka_spine_msgs/msg/UserLimits.$type: User-defined soft motion limits of the spine.
franka_spine_msgs/msg/UserLimits.lower_limit: User-defined lower spine travel limit in metres.
franka_spine_msgs/msg/UserLimits.upper_limit: User-defined upper spine travel limit in metres.

franka_spine_msgs/srv/FaultReset.$type: Reset the spine from Fault to SwitchedOff.

franka_spine_msgs/srv/GetParameters.$type: Read spine parameters, including the configured user limits.

franka_spine_msgs/srv/GetSpineState.$type: Read the current spine state and reported errors.

franka_spine_msgs/action/MoveAbsolute.$type: Absolute spine motion with a target in metres and positive velocity, acceleration and deceleration.

action_msgs/msg/GoalStatus.$type: Action protocol state associated with a goal.

action_msgs/msg/GoalStatusArray.$type: Statuses of the goals reported by an action server.

action_msgs/srv/CancelGoal.$type: Select goals by UUID and acceptance time. A zero UUID selects all goals at or before the timestamp, or every goal if the timestamp is zero. A nonzero UUID selects that goal and, when the timestamp is nonzero, all goals accepted at or before it.

geometry_msgs/msg/AccelStamped.$type: Acceleration in a named frame at a specified time.

geometry_msgs/msg/InertiaStamped.$type: Inertia in a named frame at a specified time.

geometry_msgs/msg/PoseStamped.$type: Pose in a named frame at a specified time.

geometry_msgs/msg/TwistStamped.$type: Twist in a named frame at a specified time.

geometry_msgs/msg/Vector3Stamped.$type: Vector in a named frame at a specified time.

geometry_msgs/msg/WrenchStamped.$type: Wrench in a named frame at a specified time.

std_msgs/msg/Header.$type: Timestamp and coordinate frame attached to a sample.

unique_identifier_msgs/msg/UUID.$type: Sixteen octets of a universally unique identifier.

franka_spine_msgs/action/MoveAbsolute_Go.position: Target absolute spine position in metres.
franka_spine_msgs/action/MoveAbsolute_Go.velocity: Motion velocity in m/s, strictly greater than zero.
franka_spine_msgs/action/MoveAbsolute_Go.acceleration: Motion acceleration in m/s², strictly greater than zero.
franka_spine_msgs/action/MoveAbsolute_Go.deceleration: Motion deceleration in m/s², strictly greater than zero.
